title: World package manifest (world.json in a .cwp)
description: What a generated world is: its geographic origin, how its roads were seated on the photoreal imagery, the imagery layers, the traffic staging rectangle, and how it was built. Keys are PascalCase. CARLA's frame has x east, y south and z up, in meters. Heights are WGS84 ellipsoidal heights in meters.

FormatVersion.description: The format of this file. A manifest without it is version 1.

Producer.description: What made the package. Absent from a package written before it was recorded.

MapName.description: The world's name. The package file is <MapName>.cwp.

OriginHeightMeters.description: Ellipsoidal height, meters, that CARLA's z = 0 stands for.

GeoReferenceString.description: The OpenDRIVE geoReference projection, a PROJ string, copied verbatim from map.xodr. Empty when the OpenDRIVE carries none.

HeightAlignMode.description: How roads were seated on the photoreal imagery: none, area, origin or drape.

DrapeActive.description: True when the drivable surface was fitted to the imagery cell by cell, and bareearth.bin holds the grids.

HeightAlignOffsetMeters.description: The one height, meters, added to the road surface by the area and origin modes. 0 for none and for drape.

GridMinXMeters.description: CARLA x, meters, of the grid's first column. 0 when there is no grid.

GridMinYMeters.description: CARLA y, meters, of the grid's first row. 0 when there is no grid.

GridCellSizeMeters.description: Spacing, meters, between grid points. 0 when there is no grid.

GridNumCols.description: Grid points along x. 0 when there is no grid.

GridNumRows.description: Grid points along y. 0 when there is no grid.

BareEarthOffsetSha1.description: SHA-1, lowercase hexadecimal, of the offset plane's bytes in bareearth.bin. Empty when there is no grid, and on older packages.

BareEarthDtmSha1.description: SHA-1, lowercase hexadecimal, of the ground height plane's bytes in bareearth.bin. Empty when there is no grid, and on older packages.

PhotorealIonAssetId.description: Cesium ion asset id of the photoreal imagery tileset.

GroundIonAssetId.description: Cesium ion asset id of the bare-earth terrain the road heights were taken from. 1 is Cesium World Terrain; 0 means heights came from the photoreal surface.

StagingMinXMeters.description: CARLA x, meters, of the staging rectangle's west edge.

StagingMinYMeters.description: CARLA y, meters, of the staging rectangle's north edge.

StagingMaxXMeters.description: CARLA x, meters, of the staging rectangle's east edge.

StagingMaxYMeters.description: CARLA y, meters, of the staging rectangle's south edge.

StagingMarginMeters.description: Width, meters, of the ring inside the staging rectangle where traffic enters and leaves.

SourceOsmFileName.description: File name of the OpenStreetMap extract the world was built from.

SourceOsmSha256.description: Fingerprint of that extract: SHA-256 over its parsed content, not its bytes. Older packages hold a digest of the bytes instead.

OpenDriveSha256.description: SHA-256 of map.xodr from its root element on, with the header's date blanked.

NetworkFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of map.net.xml: SHA-256 over its parsed content. Empty on a package without a network.

NetconvertArgv.description: Every argument netconvert was given, in order. Its output files are named <opendrive-output>, <output-file> and <tllogic-files>.

NetconvertPath.description: The netconvert executable that ran. Empty on older packages.

NetconvertVersion.description: What that netconvert reported as its version, such as Eclipse SUMO netconvert 1.27.0. Empty on older packages.

SampleStepMeters.description: Spacing, meters, of the road reference-line height samples.

TerrainResolutionMeters.description: Spacing, meters, of the drivable surface points in drape mode.

TerrainMarginMeters.description: The staging margin the build was asked for, meters.

GeneratedAtUtc.description: When the package was written, ISO 8601 UTC.

GeneratorVersion.description: Assembly version of the CarlaNet client that wrote the package.

NetconvertExtraArgs.description: The arguments, among NetconvertArgv, that the caller added to the standard set.

producer.title: What made the file
producer.description: The tool that wrote the file and its release, the CarlaNet release the process loaded, the CARLA server's build identity where a server was used, the SUMO release where SUMO ran, and when the file was written.

tool.description: The component that wrote the file, such as carlacontrol.SumoCotBridge, or the program's name where no component declared itself.

tool_version.description: The release of the package the tool comes from, such as 0.10.0 or 0.10.0+g1a2b3c4d5. Null where it did not say.

carlanet.description: The CarlaNet release the process loaded. Null in a Python process that never loaded CarlaNet.

server.description: The CARLA server's build identity, where a server was used. Null where none was.

sumo.description: The SUMO release, such as 1.27.0, where SUMO ran. Null where it did not.

written_utc.description: When the file was written, UTC to the millisecond. Left out of a file that two runs of one input must write byte for byte.

server_identity.title: A server's build identity
server_identity.description: What the server answered when asked what it was built from. A value the server cannot know is the word unknown.

release.description: The CARLA release the server was compiled with.

world_interface.description: The world interface version the server declares, Major.Minor.

build.description: package for a cooked server, editor for one run from the editor.

configuration.description: The build configuration, such as Development or Shipping.

commits_from.description: Where the commits came from: version_file, the package's VERSION file; compiled, the CARLA commit compiled into an editor build; or none.

server_identity_unavailable.title: A server that could not say what it was built from
server_identity_unavailable.description: A server built before it could answer, or one that could not be asked: what its older calls still say, and why.

world_interface.description: The world interface version, or unknown.

reason.description: Why the identity is not available.
